value.title: Wild Times
value.synopsis: Episodes that were only released on the DVD afterwards and didn't air on TV. Strange packs of cats have been roaming the town recently, and Tama is among them. Yurie follows her and turns into a cat to meet the charismatic feline Tyler Meowden, who wants to revolt against humans. She and Tama fight to stop him.

value.title: Love is Missing
value.synopsis: Episodes that were only released on the DVD afterwards and didn't air on TV. Miko and Shoukichi run away to a nearby town together for mysterious reasons. Yurie and her friends spend the day trying to find them.

value.title: Do What We Want
value.synopsis: Episodes that were only released on the DVD afterwards and didn't air on TV. Matsuri, as the daughter of the shrine, becomes offended by the foreign holiday of Christmas and stages "Yurie-chan Thanksgiving Day" in order to combat it.

value.title: Take a Look, Spring Has Come
value.synopsis: Episodes that were only released on the DVD afterwards and didn't air on TV. Yurie and Mitsue help Matsuri and Miko clean the shrine storage rooms. As she spends the night there, Yurie tells her friends that Kenji is her boyfriend.
